description.en: The ID of the interactive messaging application.

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

description.zh:
群组状态，默认值为0。取值：
- 0：查询全部群组。
- 1：查询未被删除群组。
- 2：查询已删除群组。
description.en:
The status of the groups to query. Default value: 0. Valid values:

*   0: all groups
*   1: existing groups
*   2: deleted groups

description.zh:
取第几页，取值范围为：\[1,10000\]。

默认值为1。
description.en:
The page number. Valid values: \[1,10000].

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页大小，取值范围为：\[1,50\]。

默认值为20。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:\[1,50].

Default value: 20.

description.zh:
排序方式，按群组创建时间先后进行排序。取值：
- 1：正序。
- 2：逆序。
description.en:
The sort order based on the time when the groups were created. Valid values:

*   1: ascending order
*   2: descending order

title.zh: 查询互动消息群组列表（支持翻页）

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~)创建互动消息群组。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, make sure that you have called the [CreateLiveMessageGroup](~~2848163~~) operation to create an interactive messaging group.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live list-live-message-group-by-page --app-id demo --sort-type 1 --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --group-status 1 --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
